usage: tr usage [-h] [--by {arm,call,day,model,run,step,tag}] [--run RUN_ID]
                [--since DATE] [--step STEP] [--tag TAG] [--all-dirs]

cost per run, arm, day, call, step, model or tag from the saved run files and
the cost ledger, then the OpenRouter key's lifetime spend and the two
reconciled (free reads)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --by {arm,call,day,model,run,step,tag}
                        group the calls by (default run)
  --run RUN_ID          only this run's calls
  --since DATE          only calls on or after this New York date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --step STEP           only runs of this step (the ledger's, e.g. analyze or
                        worker)
  --tag TAG             only runs saved under this TR_COST_TAG (e.g.
                        worker:G99)
  --all-dirs            every runs directory under data/ and data-dev/, plus
                        the ledger rows whose run file is gone, one row per
                        run id
